Description
A crossbow bolt used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (critical multiplier x2). items.name: Chelish Navy Pattern Heavy Crossbow
items.description: This finely wrought heavy crossbow is standard issue aboard Chelish naval vessels. Featuring burnished brass fittings, a reinforced steel prod, and a hardwood stock lacquered in crimson and black (the colors of House Thrune), it exemplifies both state pride and battlefield efficiency. Despite lacking magical enhancements, it is a weapon of superior construction, built to endure brutal salt-weathered campaigns and still punch through enemy hulls or pierce a pirate captain's throat at 120 feet.

items.name: Chelish Service Saber
items.description:
The Chelish Service Saber is the standard-issue melee weapon for trusted crew aboard Chelish naval vessels—such as boatswains, veteran navigators, and long-serving able seamen. It strikes a balance between form and function: simple enough to mass-produce for the imperial navy, but elegant enough to signal discipline and readiness.
